archetype: Archetype 2: The Performance Pro (Adapted for Community Hub)

layout_and_spacing.spacing_system: Generous spacing. Use p-8, p-12, py-24 for marketing sections.
layout_and_spacing.grid_mode: MODE A: 'Tetris' Grid for Activities bento box. MODE B: 'Control Room' for Admin Dashboard.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Optical alignment, mostly left-aligned text blocks with bold headers. Asymmetric layouts preferred.
layout_and_spacing.corners: rounded-none or max rounded-sm for a sharp, disciplined athletic feel.

components.buttons: Sharp edges, high contrast. Primary CTA: bg-[#E63946] text-white hover:bg-red-700. Secondary: border-2 border-[#0033A0] text-[#0033A0] hover:bg-[#0033A0] hover:text-white.
components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow by default. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-lg.
components.schedule_table: Custom grid or list. MUST include a blinking green dot (`animate-pulse bg-green-500 rounded-full h-3 w-3 inline-block`) next to the current active class.
components.header: Sticky with backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/90. High contrast nav links.
components.footer: Deep blue background (bg-[#0B205A]) with white text. Incorporate the secondary logo (triangle with fist in black/orange/yellow) here.

media_and_images.description: Empty indoor stadium with blue and red mat. Use as a fallback if the user's real local photo is not found. Overlay with black/blue gradient to ensure text readability.
Kids learning martial arts, representing inclusion and family-friendly dojo.
Adults practicing BJJ, for the modalities bento section.
Athletes practicing boxing with punching bags indoors.
Ballet dancers practicing, highlighting the cultural academy aspect.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All buttons and interactive cards must have transform transitions (e.g., hover:-translate-y-1).
motion_and_interactions.live_indicator: Use 'animate-pulse' on the green dot in the schedule to show it is live.
motion_and_interactions.scroll_effects: Use subtle fade-in-up animations for sections as they scroll into view.

instructions_to_main_agent: Create a Hybrid Fullstack app (Marketing site + Admin dashboard).
Use pure HTML + Tailwind for marketing layouts (bento grids, overlapping elements), but use Shadcn for complex interactive components (forms, dialogs).
Schedule Logic: Implement logic that checks the current time in Brasília timezone (America/Sao_Paulo) and renders a blinking green dot on the ongoing class.
Include a prominent WhatsApp CTA 'Agendar aula experimental' linking to +55 21 98080-4225.
Include Instagram link (@ctwinnerrj) in header and footer.
Load Bebas Neue and Outfit fonts from Google Fonts.
The Footer MUST use the secondary logo (triangle with fist in black/orange/yellow). Look for it in the local assets. If absent, create a CSS representation or use a suitable icon placeholder.
The primary hero background should use the user's provided real photo if available locally. If not, fallback to the media_and_images.hero_background URL.
Build an Admin Dashboard (accessible via /admin) featuring CRUD capabilities for Schedules, Events, and Modalities.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
Maintain high contrast. Deep Cobalt Blue as primary anchor, Red as energetic accent.
pages_to_build: Home: Hero Banner 'Lugar especial para pessoas especiais', Activities Bento, Values/About summary, Events snippet, WhatsApp CTA.
Activities: Detailed bento grid or list of modalities (Taekwondo, Jiu-Jitsu, Boxe, Muay-thai, Judô, Karatê, Teatro, Balé).
Schedule: Grid or List view (Day x Time x Professor) with the Live Blinking Dot.
About Us: History, Team, Values (Respect, Discipline, Inclusion), Space Structure timeline, Location Map (R. Lopes da Cruz, 61 - Méier, RJ).
Admin Dashboard: Secured CRUD panel for schedules, events, and modalities.
